title: From Replication to Redesign: Exploring Pairwise Comparisons for LLM-Based Peer Review

bias_targets.methodology: Tracking the first authors' affiliation distribution across accepted papers and calculating the Gini coefficient to quantify the degree of publication concentration among established institutions.

Comparing the acceptance rates of the LLM ranking system versus human reviewers across different primary research areas (e.g., applied fields like robotics vs. theoretical fields like learning theory).

Embedding paper abstracts using a text-embedding model and computing nearest neighbor distances to quantify topic similarity, evaluating whether the LLM system prefers papers similar to existing literature over highly novel ones.
